observations.statement: The native ledger contract requires per-ledger monotonic event identity, duplicate-event idempotency, CAS record upserts, atomic turn commits, idempotent recovery, and a blocked synchronization state that disables topic advance, compile, approval, and handoff until all projections agree.

Runtime certification is required to reject dangling, orphaned, cross-project, cross-snapshot, stale-revision, wrong-kind, and hash-mismatched references and to report edge, stale, orphan, repair, and projection-hash evidence.

Project context distinguishes greenfield, local Git, local non-Git, remote Git, remote non-Git, and fork/upstream variants, with variant-specific required and forbidden fake fields and five currentness-hash inputs.

PRD source intake requires preservation, MIME verification, sandbox/security checks, quarantine disposition, explicit resource ceilings, and a terminal intake receipt; blocked or quarantined sources cannot be silently approved.

Large-source extraction is specified as multiple bounded, read-only assignments that treat prompt injection as content, while reduced PRD atoms have a single controller writer and duplicates/conflicts remain traceable.

Coverage and quality readiness require non-empty coverage, zero blocking findings, and zero blocking uncovered spans; security, resource, quarantine, degraded-source, and warning evidence must carry forward.
Annotations preserve stale selected text and its hash, apply only to current or evidence-backed relocated anchors, and require stable ordering within document version and actor.

Planning Wizard runtime defines topic maps, explicit topic operation events, topic drafts, amendments, audit cycles, integration, and final certification, with evidence-gated readiness and one-Planning-Run ledger containment.
Planning Run input may be an immutable Approved PRD Pack, a normalized requirements pack, or an Assistant Chat handoff seed; compatible work intents can remain distinct and coexist.

Approve And Build compares eleven named CAS values, fails closed on drift, atomically writes the approval receipt and PlanApproved, synchronously returns a PlanCompileRun identity, and intends duplicate delivery to return that existing run.

The compile pipeline normalizes PlanUnits, discovers test and source-control capabilities, builds typed dependencies and bounded surfaces, classifies risk and authority, drafts and independently reviews non-executable NodeSeeds, constructs WorkGraph and WorkNodeRequest artifacts, audits them, submits them to Executor intake, activates them atomically, and projects launch state to Orchestrator.

GUI-facing truth appears in normalization classification, visual/headed capability probing, explicit user-visible risk, immediate navigation to Plan Compile, and delayed exposure of Open Build until activation and a durable start receipt.

Static file presence, parsing, schemas, and contract scenarios are explicitly insufficient for runtime readiness; fresh readiness requires executable-harness artifacts after explicit runtime enablement.

WorkNode runtime requires one immutable-source WorkNodeRecord per accepted request, monotonic attempts, CAS state transitions, rollback disposition before mutation, exact request-to-record cardinality, and retention of failed-attempt evidence.

Executor activation names six states, resumes activation idempotently, returns the existing GoalRun for duplicate idempotency keys, forbids partial activation after mixed acceptance, queues entrypoints before active projection, and requires exactly-once BuildStarted delivery.

The contextual testing contract requires evidence for harness and test passes, interaction evidence for visible sessions, explicit authority for restricted testing, truthful exception labels, and cleanup or approved retention for temporary installations.

Named authorities and consumers include the PLS-015 ledger service owner, the storage plan, the PRD reduction controller, amendment and testing approvers, Planning Run, PlanCompileRun, Executor, GoalRun, and Orchestrator.

candidate_findings.statement: The upsert CAS obligation is not fully executable from its required fields: only one revision value is required, with no explicit expected/current pair, comparison target, conflict result, or retry behavior.

The general ledger guard requires idempotency keys, but commit_turn and recover_turn require no idempotency key or CAS value; replay and concurrent-recovery winner behavior are therefore left to the builder despite mandatory atomicity and idempotent recovery.

Cross-snapshot rejection cannot be tied to explicit snapshot identity using the declared edge fields because edge authority omits snapshot_id and snapshot_version even though both are declared snapshot identity fields.

The project-context contract lists variant definitions but does not require a selected variant discriminator in snapshot identity or state exactly-one and mixed-variant rejection rules, leaving ambiguous snapshot classification discretionary.

source_intake_terminal_receipt requires terminal_state but the reviewed core does not enumerate its legal values or transitions, and it does not require user_authority_ref_or_null to be non-null when the resource state is user_authority_required.

Unsafe-source and over-limit conditions block only until receipt-backed disposition, but the reviewed core does not define disposition kinds, approving authority, or evidence sufficient to select degraded_source instead of blocking or quarantine.
Large sources must use multiple bounded extraction assignments, but neither the threshold for large nor the minimum assignment count, partition completeness rule, or overlap policy is specified.

An extraction result may contain no candidate atoms whenever a warning explains the outcome, but no warning class, approval requirement, or sufficiency criterion prevents an arbitrary warning from masking failed extraction.

Reduction reserves writes to the controller, yet reduction_receipt has no controller identity or authority field; additionally, conflict resolution requires claims and evidence while the reduction record exposes only conflict_refs and no resolution binding.

Coverage readiness depends on zero blocking uncovered spans, but coverage_report exposes uncovered_spans without a blocking classification, disposition, approver, or rule for deciding which uncovered spans block.

Annotation application depends on current or evidence-backed relocated anchor_state, but the reviewed core supplies neither the legal anchor states nor relocation-validation, overlap, or concurrent-document-change rules.

topic_operation_event lacks planning_run_id, topic_map_id, prior version, causation identity, and idempotency key even though topic maps are Planning-Run-, map-, and version-scoped, leaving event binding and replay semantics ambiguous.
A topic audit can pass when findings are marked false_positive, but topic_audit_cycle requires no false-positive rationale, evidence reference, or approving authority.
Final integration permits required topics to be explicitly excluded, but final_integration has no exclusion list, reason, risk, evidence, or exclusion approver field.

Approve And Build duplicate-delivery behavior depends on an idempotency key that is absent from approve_and_build_cas_fields and from any approval record definition in the reviewed core, leaving its source, scope, and required persistence unspecified.

The approval atomic boundary explicitly covers approval_cas_receipt and PlanApproved, while PlanCompileRun creation is separately required synchronously; rollback or recovery behavior if run creation fails after approval is not specified.

Mandatory parallel review depends on undefined qualifiers such as broad scope and large scope, and the reviewed core does not specify reviewer count, partition coverage, result aggregation, timeout, or disagreement handling.

GUI work is classified and visual/headed capabilities are probed, but normalized rows have no stated GUI field or taxonomy and no mandatory rule binds a GUI unit to visible-session, visual-oracle, screenshot, or interaction evidence.

final_compile_audit_repair outputs only audit_report and repair_closure_matrix, while the next stage consumes certified_workgraph and certified_worknode_requests; no stage output or binding rule creates those certified inputs.

orchestrator_projection lists activation_transition_receipts, PlanCompileRun, and GoalRun as inputs but permits entry on PlanApproved alone; behavior when the required launch identities or activation receipt are not yet available is unspecified.

Compile terminal states are stated as predicates, but the reviewed core defines no PlanCompileRun state record, legal transition graph, per-stage revision/idempotency envelope, or restart/cancellation protocol despite requiring restart and cancellation certification.

worknode_attempt requires only identity, start, model, capabilities, and safe point, while its invariant and attempt_rules require budget, timeout, expected outputs, validators, priority, retry taxonomy, cancellation, and rollback; those required field names and shapes are missing.

WorkNodeRecord carries lifecycle and transition receipts block invalid transitions, but the reviewed core supplies no WorkNode lifecycle-state enumeration or legal from_state/to_state transition table.

rollback_policy has no policy_id, worknode_id, attempt_id, revision, or authority binding even though mutation must not start without rollback disposition and every attempt must carry rollback policy.

Cardinality rules require completion receipts keyed by worknode_id and attempt_id, but no completion-receipt record kind, fields, terminal invariants, or receipt reference are defined in worknode_runtime.

activation_decision records accepted_scope_refs but has no expected-active-scope snapshot, expected count/hash, rejected refs, or mixed-result disposition, so its fields cannot by themselves prove that all required active-scope requests were accepted together.

Executor activation enumerates states but defines no permitted transition graph; activation_transition_receipt also lacks activation revision, CAS value, and idempotency key despite restart-safe state being required.

The transactional outbox promises exactly-once BuildStarted delivery, but no event identity, deduplication key, delivery acknowledgement, retry state, or consumer-side idempotency evidence is required.

explicit_non_gaps.statement: The ledger contract does explicitly state CAS, idempotency, atomic-turn, thread/run/topic binding, source-lineage, blocked-recovery, and no-partial-projection requirements.
Prompt injection and untrusted source authority are explicitly handled: assignments are read-only and source text is content rather than assistant instruction or policy authority.
Project variants explicitly prohibit several common fabricated fields, including fake Git identifiers for non-Git/greenfield contexts and local-worktree authority for remote Git.
Assistant Chat seeds are explicitly required to record assumptions rather than invent missing project facts and are bound to one Planning Run ledger.
NodeSeed candidates are explicitly non-executable intermediate proposals, require non-empty acceptance and validators, and must receive independent review before graph construction.
The contract explicitly prevents schema-only or static-scenario evidence from being treated as native runtime certification.
Partial-build behavior is explicit: mixed Executor acceptance cannot launch a partial build, and cancellation before mutation performs no repository mutation.
Testing exceptions cannot be mislabeled as full passes: restricted testing requires explicit user approval and produces only a truthful exception or blocked label.

unknowns.statement: Whether the referenced canonical schemas define the omitted receipt shapes, state enums, common record envelopes, CAS conflicts, or certified artifact bindings is unanswerable within the allowed capsule.
Whether the named service-owner and storage-authority documents close ledger sequencing, idempotency, transaction, and recovery details is unanswerable within the allowed capsule.
Canonical serialization, hash algorithms, freshness boundaries, and collision/version handling for currentness_hash and its five component hashes are not established in this window.
No conclusion about actual runtime enablement or executable certification can be drawn from this contract window; the text itself distinguishes targets from execution proof.
Testing behavior after source line 168, including any additional GUI-oracle, restart, cancellation, or negative-case records, is outside the permitted window.
